t: There is hereby appropriated $650,000, to remain available until expended, to carry out provisions of section 751 of division A of Public Law 108–7.

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation of funds to carry out a provision of another law. A tempting reading is that the cross-referenced section 751 might involve some outside-party process, but nothing in this section's text itself provides for consultation, comment, hearings, advisory bodies, rulemaking, or a right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision here.
fable.s: There is hereby appropriated $650,000, to remain available until expended, to carry out provisions of section 751 of division A of Public Law 108–7.

It creates no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. The cross-reference to section 751 might suggest some underlying process, but nothing in this text shows one, and funding language alone is not participation.
opus.s: There is hereby appropriated $650,000, to remain available until expended, to carry out provisions of section 751 of division A of Public Law 108–7.
